title: The capacity band does not hold the charge between the BMS stops
found: On 200 synthetic packs the monthly 90 % band held the charge between the stops at the date in 2278 of 4782 month ends (48 %); the estimate reads +0.47 points of nominal capacity above it on average. Against the capacity between the rest voltages it reports, the band held 4248 of 4562 (93 %), -0.04 points on average; that truth was chosen after the first results. On the same seeds with one state-of-charge path (a pack whose BMS copy equals its plant) it held 3827 of 4569 (84 %); [simulator](05_simulator.md#the-rerun-on-one-state-of-charge-path).

title: Storage at a middle state of charge gets a wrong capacity
found: Do not use the capacity (A1) on storage that works at a middle state of charge. Version 0.2 takes the edges of the daily window for full and empty and reports the charge between them as the capacity, with the status `estimated`. On simulated packs cycled daily between 25 and 75 % it reports a median 51 to 56 % of the true capacity (9 settings of 200 packs: a full charge every week, every month or never).

title: Apparent charge loss (A4) was biased
found: The band held the true drain in 188 of 200 packs (94 %). The estimate is off by -0.03 mA on average (standard deviation 0.19 mA) on a true drain of 50 mA, just outside ±0.03 (2 sd/√200): a small bias remains.
